page.title: Sites
page.description: Work as several sites in one install: each site has its own people and calendar, and the reports can compare them.
page.denied: Access Denied. Only administrators can manage sites.
page.load_failed: The sites could not be loaded.

enable.label: Work as several sites
enable.help: A site is a top-level place of type site (see Settings, Locations). Once this is on, a person assigned to one or more sites sees only those sites' places, assets, work orders, preventive maintenance and sensors, plus anything that is not in any site. Administrators, and people assigned to no site, see everything. Vendors and people are shared by all sites.
enable.confirm_on: Switch sites on? The top-level places of type site count as sites, and a person you assign to sites will only see those. People assigned to no site keep seeing everything.
enable.confirm_off: Switch sites off? Everyone will see everything again. Who works where, and each site's calendar, are kept for when you switch it on again.
enable.off_note: Sites are off: everyone sees everything, whatever the sites below say.

add.title: Add a site
add.name: Site name
add.none: There are no sites yet. Add one, or turn a top-level place into a site in Settings, Locations (a place with no parent, of type site).
